notes.title: English Subtitle Released!
notes.notes:
After several rounds of translation and proof-reading, we finally released the English subtitle for “Cross Princess” ! Let us know if you find any issues about the script line. We hope you would enjoy the game!

If you missed script lines or would like to check the previous line, just scroll up the mouse wheel to open the history panel.

notes.title: If you cannot launch game on Win10
notes.notes:
Beside to 'verifying the content' of the game, you could try:

1. From "Properties/ Browse Local Files" to find the installation directory.
2. Then select the execution file, right-click it and select properties/compatibility tab.
3. Then select the checkbox to run in it in Windows 7 compatible mode.

We will continue to track down and fix this issue.
